notes: «وذكر ابن عياش قال اجتمعت يوما مع أبي دلف» is Ibn Ayyash's own account; Abu Dulaf speaks in the story («فقال لي»), so he is the last link (owner ruling 5).
«وذكر ابن نوح طرفا من ذلك» names another narrator but gives no saying, so it is not a route.
The long passage about Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi is the story's content, not chain material; no names in it are links.
